# change-risk

> Deterministic change risk tiers (low, standard, high, emergency) for a source change, from the
> paths it touches, a sensitivity map and tier policy read from the target branch, declarations
> that can only raise it, an emergency label applied by an allowed declarer, and other tools'
> findings. Outputs an in-toto predicate that agent-change-control consumes. Rust CLI `crisk`.

Rules: no content analysis, no model; the map and policy are read from the base revision; a change
to `.change-risk/` is always high; declarations only raise; an emergency needs a forge label event by
an allowed declarer. Reason codes CR001 to CR012; exit codes 0 to 7 (1 tier at or above --fail-on,
4 incomplete).
